Title: Ajay and the Family

Cast

1. Ajay - 34 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Anita - 60 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Manoj - 37 years, friend
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The hospital ward - Day

[Ajay is asleep in bed in the ward. Anita and Manoj stand near him.]

Ajay: "What lovely weather!"

[After a long illness Ajay passes away in his hospital bed.]

Anita (excited): "Rest in peace."
